assessment.rationale: No pharmacy prints vaccines anywhere, so the Main KPI of 200,000 pharmacies with vaccine printers is untouched. The entire indexed prior art for a vaccine printer is a single bench result, the microneedle vaccine printer for thermostable COVID-19 mRNA vaccines in Nature Biotechnology (online 2023, issue 2024), which a title search shows is the only publication of its kind (https://www.ebi.ac.uk/europepmc/webservices/rest/search?query=TITLE%3A%22vaccine%20printer%22&format=json&pageSize=5&resultType=lite). Distributed point-of-care manufacturing exists only as proposals and adjacent cases across 22 records: synthetic-biology vaccine industry commentary, cell-free distributed manufacturing of the antiviral protein griffithsin, and autologous cell-therapy network logistics (https://www.ebi.ac.uk/europepmc/webservices/rest/search?query=%22point-of-care%22%20AND%20%22distributed%20manufacturing%22%20AND%20vaccine&format=json&pageSize=8&resultType=lite). No trial of a point-of-care or distributed-manufactured vaccine is registered (https://clinicaltrials.gov/api/v2/studies?query.term=distributed+manufacturing+mRNA+vaccine+point+of+care&pageSize=10), and the only open-source project surfaced is a single unstarred vaccine distribution database model (https://api.github.com/search/repositories?q=pharmacy+vaccine+inventory+management&per_page=10). Honest limit: the printer prototype is fully published, so a task that only rebuilds a microneedle patch printer is a known answer; the open work is release testing, sterility, potency assay and regulatory acceptance of a dose made outside a licensed plant, which no source addresses, and the unresolved question of who carries liability for a locally printed dose.

additionalSearches.finding: Exactly one indexed record: 'A microneedle vaccine printer for thermostable COVID-19 mRNA vaccines', Nature Biotechnology (online April 2023, 2024 issue). The concept rests on one laboratory prototype; nothing reports deployment, regulatory clearance or pharmacy use.

additionalSearches.query: point-of-care and distributed vaccine manufacturing literature
additionalSearches.finding: 22 hits, all proposals or adjacent work: building a sustainable vaccines industry with synthetic biology (Trends Biotechnol 2021), rapid distributed manufacturing of griffithsin with cell-free systems (N Biotechnol 2023), distributed autologous cell-therapy network logistics (2026), pandemic-preparedness investment pieces. No distributed vaccine manufacturing in routine use.

additionalSearches.query: registered trials of point-of-care or distributed-manufactured vaccines
additionalSearches.finding: The registry returned an empty studies array: no clinical trial of a vaccine made at the point of care, so the regulatory path for a locally printed dose is untested in humans.

One repository (ranade-ame/Vaccination-Distribution-Management-System, 0 stars), a database model for tracking supply and recipients. No open-source vaccine printer, formulation controller or release-testing system exists.
